notes.title: One send path, owner-triggered
notes.text: Only Today's Send and a conversation's Send call sendMessage. It claims the row (draft|failed→sending), checks stage, rolling-24h limits, replies and in-touch, then sends via Gmail, queues a worker run for LinkedIn, or just records an X DM. Crons draft and detect; they never send.

notes.title: State lives in Postgres
notes.text: ingest dedupes companies/fits/people/signals; messages go draft→sending→sent/failed/skipped, with replies stored as received rows. Credentials are sealed in connections; refresh merges runtime.health, which Today shows as Needs attention.

notes.title: Failure and isolation
notes.text: If the in-touch check fails, nothing is sent. A LinkedIn run still going after 75s stays 'sending' until refresh resolves it. The worker only browses allowed domains and holds runs while the home exit node is down (24h queue TTL). A run cut off by a restart is marked failed and is not replayed.

views.title: Which parts make up Outbound and who coordinates them?
views.scope: Owner UI, the Vercel app and engine, the Postgres CRM and the LinkedIn worker

notes.title: Engine is the decision maker
notes.text: Pages and actions are thin. lib/engine.ts decides research, enrollment, drafting, sending and when to stop on a reply. The email, LinkedIn and refresh views have the details.

notes.title: Owner-only gate
notes.text: Pages call requireOwner(); every server action runs through run() → assertOwner(), allowlisted to OWNER_EMAIL.

views.title: What happens when the owner clicks Send on an email draft?
views.scope: Workflow A, email channel: claim, guards, Gmail threaded send

notes.title: Guards before Gmail
notes.text: Closed stage → skipped; over daily limit → failed; already replied → skipped; in touch outside sequence → failed unless Include anyway.

notes.title: Follow-ups thread
notes.text: Follow-ups reuse the last threadId, 'Re: <first subject>' and In-Reply-To = stored RFC Message-ID.

views.title: How does a LinkedIn send run in the browser worker?
views.scope: Workflow A, LinkedIn channel: queued run, home-IP egress, poll for outcome

notes.title: Home route required
notes.text: Before each run the worker checks that Tailscale reports the exit node online and that the proxy IP differs from Fly's. Otherwise the run waits, up to a 24h TTL.

notes.title: Async confirm
notes.text: The app polls up to 75s; unfinished runs stay 'sending' and refresh() resolves them later.

views.title: What triggers refresh and what does it update?
views.scope: Workflow B: daily Vercel cron and hourly Fly trigger into refresh + fillPipeline

notes.title: Bounded under 300s
notes.text: The cron route has maxDuration 300 and gives fillPipeline a 230s deadline. A failed check is recorded as a health problem and refresh keeps going.

notes.title: Never sends
notes.text: refresh confirms LinkedIn runs, detects replies, drafts due steps and fills the CRM; it does not enroll or send.

views.title: Which external systems does refresh reach?
views.scope: Workflow B steps B3–B6: Gmail reply checks, LinkedIn reads, LLM, sourcing

notes.title: Scraped text is untrusted
notes.text: Website/HN/YC/LinkedIn text is fenced in <untrusted> tags for the model; website fetches pass an SSRF guard.

notes.title: Worker uses OpenRouter too
notes.text: browser-use agent steps call OpenRouter (BROWSER_MODEL) directly from the Fly worker, not via the Vercel app.

views.title: How do locally scouted companies enter the CRM?
views.scope: scout CLI using owner's yc/gh/bird logins → /api/import → ingest

notes.title: Local-only X search
notes.text: bird needs the owner's browser cookies, so X sourcing runs only from the laptop via pnpm scout x.

notes.title: Import auth and validation
notes.text: /api/import accepts an IMPORT_TOKEN or CRON_SECRET bearer. An unknown project or persona, or a payload that fails the zod check, returns 400.

views.title: How do the owner's sign-ins and X DMs work?
views.scope: Google sign-in and Gmail grant, LinkedIn sign-in inside the worker, manual X DM

notes.title: LinkedIn sign-in in worker
notes.text: Settings streams the worker's screen and relays clicks/keys; no cookie import, because LinkedIn revoked copied sessions.

notes.title: X DM is manual
notes.text: The browser opens X compose with the text prefilled. sendMessage only records the DM as sent, and replies on X aren't detected.
